purpose: Measure whether source-backed analyst proposals improve a fixed coding agent on independently graded tasks after accounting for collection, labeling, analysis, implementation and trial overhead.

software_choice.harness: Harbor, pinned exact source/release before execution
software_choice.benchmark_candidate: Terminal-Bench 4.1; select fresh tasks by metadata after reservation audit
software_choice.grader: Official task verifier in a separate evaluator environment; do not build a replacement grading framework
software_choice.trace_exchange: Harbor ATIF plus exact native Codex JSONL and original tool I/O
software_choice.annotation: Existing source-linked Luna analysis; audited versioned labels
software_choice.proposal_tracking: Reuse decision/implementation/evaluation/accounting separation in analyst_experiments.py; add only the missing PostgreSQL/UI integration
software_choice.why_not_new_harness: Harbor already provides task isolation, agent integration, native/ATIF artifacts, independent verification and regrading.
software_choice.license: Harbor Apache-2.0; task licenses and all dependency/image receipts must be checked individually
software_choice.pricing: No managed-provider pricing is assumed; initially use the local host and existing ChatGPT subscription. Actual cash/quota remains unknown.

allocation_proposal.purpose: Six-task pilot checks the mechanism and plumbing, not statistical noninferiority or a public leaderboard score. Size fresh selection/final panels from the observed development variance before reserving them.

budget_proposal.first_live_unit: One development task after all controls, then inspect capture and metering before proceeding
budget_proposal.scaling: Only after a retained-quality result, register separate concurrency 1/2/4 comparisons; no automatic 100-agent launch.

conditions.description: Pinned native agent/model/default tools plus passive collection; isolated task state and no optimization hints, prior task logs, personal memory or candidate changes.
Same pinned agent/model, task information and total resource regime plus exactly one reviewed reversible intervention; fresh attempt, verified activation and rollback.

artifacts: exact request/response and tool input/result bytes where available
actual tool catalog and agent configuration
rules: Preserve exact bytes before derived ingestion; raw private artifacts stay local.
Native response IDs/cumulative-counter deltas own usage; never sum ATIF and native usage or parent wrappers and child operations.
Missing or all-zero upstream usage defaults remain unknown.
Timing records distinguish recorded operation runtime, background/service lifetime, queue wait, agent-blocking time and full task elapsed time.
Preserve retries, failed/uncertain calls and coverage gaps; no silent replacement attempt.
Collection does not alter model-facing inputs; any transform is a separate intervention.

labels.audit: Audit all six development tasks at task level and a stratified step sample covering apparent success, failure and unknown. Report denominators, agreement, per-class precision/recall and disagreements; do not assume model confidence is calibrated.
labels.leakage: Grader outcomes are joined only after sealed generation. Never feed hidden grades, reference patches or future events into a solving agent or online failure detector.
labels.model_policy: Current Observatory processor/analyst execution remains gpt-6-luna through the source Codex ChatGPT subscription. A larger analyst is a separately declared study amendment, not a silent fallback.

analyst.mode: On-demand incremental review of a frozen allowed-development cohort; no scheduled inference
constraints: No edits to measured values, source logs or grader outcomes.
No raw final-evaluation data access during tuning.
Accepted for trial is not applied, verified, kept or measured saving.
Declined/later/rejected proposals persist and are suppressed until material evidence changes.

tracking.lineage: source snapshot -> label version/audit -> analyst run -> proposal -> registered trial -> sealed artifacts -> independent measurements -> review -> subsequent protocol amendment
tracking.immutability: Runner-written measurements and grader receipts are immutable; corrections/regrades create linked new records. Analyst decisions and implementation states are separate records.
tracking.existing_storage: analyst_experiments.py already retains frozen baselines, proposals, runner-written evaluations, reviews and overhead. Preserve its old records; PostgreSQL/UI port is a declared delivery gap.

quality: environment/verifier failures separate from solution failures

decision_rule.quality_gate: No observed loss of matched baseline successes; report paired losses/gains, sample size and uncertainty. A pilot is not proof of noninferiority.
decision_rule.economic_gate: Lower total model-rate scenario cost across all assigned candidate tasks with complete counters; disclose optimization overhead separately and net cost including it. Unknown counters prevent a saving claim.
decision_rule.time_gate: Latency is separate; no speedup claim without matched whole-task timing and resource regime.
decision_rule.verdict: Keep only when all preregistered gates pass; otherwise reject or inconclusive. Preserve negative and mixed outcomes.
decision_rule.predeclared_target: A useful minimum gain and any regression margin must be frozen before the first scored comparison; no 90% saving guarantee.

application_monitor.mode: read-only sequential HTTP measurements, no model calls
application_monitor.baseline_status: Not yet established; current app still has no migrated source data.

next_actions: Confirm raw storage and reconcile the real legacy import.
Validate native capture/reconciliation without changing normal routing.
Pin and review the harness, task/evaluator sources, images and environment.
Freeze fresh task allocation and a finite model budget.
Pass task-specific empty/reference and actor-boundary controls.
Run one stock development task, seal and independently grade it, audit the complete collected evidence.
Complete the bounded development baseline, label audit and one on-demand analyst review.
Register a one-mechanism matched trial, evaluate and retain keep/reject/inconclusive plus overhead.
Freeze policy before separately reserving and running fresh final evaluation.

references.purpose: Current benchmark candidate, 4.1; no task allocation made.
Maintained Apache-2.0 evaluation harness; not newly installed.
Native/ATIF artifacts and schema capability boundaries.
New linked grader results from sealed artifacts without replaying actors.
Evaluate existing datasets, scores, annotation and experiment interfaces before implementing missing links.
